description: Get near-Earth asteroids approaching within a date range (max 7 days). Returns size, velocity, and miss distance. Example: get_asteroids({ start_date: "2024-01-01", end_date: "2024-01-07", _apiKey: "DEMO_KEY" })

_apiKey.description: NASA API key (optional, defaults to DEMO_KEY)

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (max 7 days after start)

name: get_asteroids
